dishes.name: Groninger mosterdsoep
dishes.desc: Creamy soup flavoured with mustard from the province, usually with bacon. A traditional Groningen dish.

dishes.name: Groninger koek
dishes.desc: Dense spiced gingerbread cake sliced with butter. The province's breakfast staple.

dishes.name: Groninger metworst
dishes.desc: Coarse raw-cured sausage seasoned with clove and pepper. A regional speciality sold at the city's butchers.

dishes.name: Groninger eierbal
dishes.desc: Deep-fried breaded ball of ragout around a hard-boiled egg, sold in snack bars and mostly eaten in Groningen province.
